# ZenOptics

> ZenOptics is the decision intelligence platform for enterprise analytics. It brings reports, dashboards and KPIs from many BI tools into one governed catalog (Atlas), gives AI copilots and agents the business context behind that analytics (Nexus), and runs governed, auditable business workflows on top of it (Maestro).

ZenOptics, Inc. is based in San Jose, California. Contact: info@zenoptics.com. Request a demo: https://zenoptics.com/schedule-a-demo/

## Products

- [Atlas | Analytics System of Record](https://zenoptics.com/atlas/): Atlas brings reports, dashboards and KPIs from every BI tool into one governed catalog, so teams find trusted analytics and manage certification and ownership.
- [Nexus | Analytics Context Layer for AI](https://zenoptics.com/nexus/): Nexus gives AI copilots and agents the business context behind your reports and KPIs, turning governed BI metadata and KPI definitions into a context layer.
- [Maestro | Govern Analytics-Driven Decisions](https://zenoptics.com/maestro/): Maestro connects trusted analytics to business workflows. Define what people and AI agents do, require reviews and approvals, and keep a record of decisions.
